 This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour
 following:
 Order
This miscellaneous appeal filed by the appellant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 being aggrieved of award dated 7/7/2023 passed by Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Damoh in MACC No.04/2022.
2. The facts necessary for disposal of the present appeal in brief are that on 5/6/2021 when the deceased was going with another person by their motorcycle to District Hospital Damoh to give food to his relative patient. On Sagar main road village - Semra Paderiya Trala No. MP:08:HA:0127 was standing carelessly in dark without any safety signal motorcycle of deceased collided with Trala. Due to which he died during treatment. 
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellants that learned Tribunal only assumed income as Rs.5,000/- whereas on the date of accident it was Rs.8700/- per month. Multiplier applied is also as 17 while it ought to be 18 as looking to age of the deceased, therefore, the award is to be enhanced accordingly. 
7. Per contra, learned counsel for the insurance company submitted that an appropriate award has already been passed by the learned tribunal in favour of the appellants. 
Smt. Maya Bai vs Shriram Katarya on 23 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130500640/
2 8. Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on careful perusal of the record, it is found that Tribunal only assumed income as Rs.5,000/- whereas on the date of accident it was Rs.8700/-
per month. Learned Tribunal has applied multiplier of 17 in para 45 of the impugned award but learned Tribunal discussed in para 41 that the deceased was of the age group of 26 to 30, therefore,
application of multiplier is correct. But due to increase in income as Rs.8700/- per month instead of Rs.5,000/- the enhancement is more than Rs.1,00,000/- Therefore, the amount of Rs.1,00,000/-
may be enhanced in favour of the claimants/appellants. The calculation is not disputed by the learned counsel for the parties. 
9. Therefore, the facts and circumstances of the case and having regard to the evidence on record the amount of Rs.1,00,000/- is hereby enhanced in favour of the claimants/appellants in addition to the amount already awarded in favour of appellants. Other terms and conditions of the award shall remain intact. 
10. In the above terms, the appeal is allowed and disposed of. Record be sent back. 
(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE Akm Smt. Maya Bai vs Shriram Katarya on 23 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130500640/
